RoadAlert.title: RoadAlert
RoadAlert.description: Crowdsourced road enforcement, traffic accident, emergency, or hazard report shared by authenticated drivers.

userId.description: Firebase UID of the authenticated driver who created the report.

subtype.description: Specific Malaysia or Waze-compatible subtype such as roadblock, speed_trap, accident_minor, accident_major, flood, hazard, or road_closed.

street.description: Optional road, highway, or locality name.

country.description: Optional ISO country code such as MY.

status.description: Current visibility status of the alert.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when created (client must submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when last updated (client must submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

AlertVote.title: AlertVote
AlertVote.description: Per-driver confirmation or cleared vote for a road alert.

userId.description: Firebase UID of the voting driver.

vote.description: Driver feedback on whether the alert is still active.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the vote (client must submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

/road_alerts/{alertId}.description: Shared crowdsourced road enforcement, accident, emergency, and hazard alerts.

/road_alerts/{alertId}/votes/{voteUid}.description: Per-user vote records preventing duplicate confirmations or dismissals.
